d: Short, slate-grey hair is styled in a chin-length bob with thick, straight-cut bangs. Large, expressive dark-brown eyes sit on a youthful face with the apparent maturity of a child. The build is small and petite, dressed in a white short-sleeved collared shirt tucked into a high-waisted grey pleated skirt, layered with a grey pinafore-style apron and a matching olive-drab military cap. Long, dark-grey fingerless arm sleeves with red bands at the wrists cover the arms.
